# Data Pipeline Assumptions Note 3

We assume that data pipeline handling of retry interacts with dedupe; teams noted that batch depends on transform and staleness, especially under real production load. This plan holds as valid the claim that data pipeline handling of compaction interacts with checkpoint; teams noted that orchestrator depends on backfill and shard, especially under real production load, pending validation. A working assumption going into this cycle: data pipeline handling of streaming interacts with ingestion; teams noted that idempotency depends on schema and consumer, especially under real production load. Until proven otherwise, we treat it as given that data pipeline handling of throughput interacts with lineage; teams noted that materialize depends on partition and offset, especially under real production load.
